Neither quantity or quality is good
Jan 2020 • Family
Quality and quantity have gone down a lot ! Visited the restaurant with my family a couple days ago. I ordered a premium steak that costs roughly $45. It clearly says on the menu that it comes at 250gram. It came out looking obviously about 100gram ( see picture). I even asked the waitress just in case they brought the wrong order, and they insisted to me that the steak is 250gram. It doesn’t look even close. Not to mention the steak was very fatty yet dry. The fries was also dry. 

For a premium dish like this, it was a huge disappointment. I’d not recommend this place ! It’s sad because the restaurant used to be our favorite spot in District 1.

0
This restaurant AIMS to PLEASE!
Oct 2019
I was with a small tour group and our leader. We had a set price menu with a couple of choices. We walked around the city in the evening, so by the time we got to the restaurant we were all pretty hungry. It was a beautiful night, so our guide arranged to have us eat outside which was really fun. The waitstaff started hauling tables and chairs outside so that we could enjoy the evening. The food was very good. I loved the shrimp chips with the first course. The fresh spring rolls were delicious. I chose the sea bass for my main course, and it was delicious. I had not had mashed potatoes in several weeks, and they tasted delicious as well. Dessert was extra delicious because they served ice cream which is always a hit with me. Very nice restaurant with awesome service.

Poor experience
Apr 2019 • Family
Stopped here for a snack meal rather than mains. Most disappointing. Nasi Goreng had unpleasant aftertaste. Satay sticks were big but so bland. Soft drinks were at fancy restaurant prices but this is no fancy place. It’s a good location with a varied menu but lacked any quality on our visit.

When the bill arrived, it was another of these places that charge more than the menu prices. Cafe Central added an extra 5% for service and then added another 10% for “tax.” It’s especially annoying that this is added on top of the service ie taxing the service charge.

I wouldn’t recommend this place but would be interested to see if they comment. Our servers weren’t too fluent in English.

reviews.review_text:
Freddie Moffat
4 contributions
0
Good food, very expensive for what you're getting.
Jan 2019 • Family
The food was nice, nothing brilliant but it was good enough for a quick lunch. No problems there. The service was great (however English-speaking tourists might have some trouble). The location is brilliant, right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. But wow it's pricey for what you're getting. I could get better food for less and just across the road or a couple doors down. We ended up spending around 1,700,000 (one million seven hundred thousand) dong between four people and we were all surprised that's how much it cost considering what we've paid elsewhere for better food, where we've paid around 1,000,000 (one million) dong or less.

Also those moist towels they're going to give you whether you want them or not, those are going to cost you (only 3,000 (three thousand) dong each but still...) and they won't tell you. They're cheap but still would have liked to know...

It's got stuff like fish, burgers etc. so if you want some Western food then you'll find it here, but at a price.
